narration: The Moon has ice. That part is settled. What nobody can say for sure is whose water it is.
visual_brief: The Moon slowly rotating in black space, south pole turning into view.

candidates.title: Dusk on Dione
candidates.description: In this recent view of Dione, the Cassini spacecraft looks on as the moon slow rotation brings the terrain from day into night. Dione rotation period is 66 hours.

candidates.title: Rotating Globe of Ganymede Geology
candidates.description: This is a frame from an animation of a rotating globe of Jupiter moon Ganymede, with a geologic map superimposed over a global color mosaic, incorporating the best available imagery from NASA Voyager 1 and 2 spacecraft, and Galileo spacecraft.
